title: Xanthe and the Debt
premise: Zephyrine Voss, a disgraced intelligence analyst haunted by a botched operation that killed her partner, is living under a quiet arrangement in a safe house she believes is off every book. When a real-estate listing surfaces with interior photos of the house, she realizes someone inside the service is burning her location deliberately — a message, or a trap. Pulled back for one last job, she must extract Marek Ilves, a cryptographer defecting before the Geneva summit, though mounting evidence suggests Marek is bait designed to draw out the mole who betrayed her years ago. In the end Zephyrine chooses love over duty, exposing the mole at the cost of her career, and walks away with Marek — and finally sleeps through the night.
about_author: Orsen Nakamura is the pen name of a former risk analyst who spent a decade writing threat assessments before turning to fiction. They live between Lisbon and Osaka, writing at night because, as they put it, the dark is more honest.

chapters.title: The Safe House Was Never Safe
